text_block_list.text:
It had been raining continuously since 
morning that day, and the track was rough, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can clearly feel myself being calm 
enough not to care about the rough track 
or the gaze of the massive crowd.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
All the hard work I've built up with 
Trainer... All those memories of clashing 
with my rivals...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"It feels as though all of that has become 
my strength, giving me a push from 
behind."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Especially that Takarazuka Kinen where I 
battled Ryan down to the wire...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Thanks to her strong resolve, I was able 
to find my own resolve as well.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Taking the lead, the resolve to achieve 
the Mejiro family's first-ever 
Spring-Autumn Tenno Sho double...!)

In Mejiro McQueen's eyes, a raging 
determination flickered like flames...!
choice_data_list: I'm expecting great things from you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I shall do everything in my power to live 
up to your expectations.
